summary: Koil Energy Solutions filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Loan and Security Agreement with nFusion Capital Finance for a $5.0 million revolving credit facility secured by substantially all personal property assets. The facility bears interest at prime plus 4.75% (floor 6.75%) and matures in 12 months with automatic renewal. There is no change of control, no equity component, and no special-situation event. This is a routine debt financing arrangement.
